span.p:
01 · Student request
Question, selected SQL or quotation

span.p:
02 · Capture request ownership
Workspace, conversation, database identity and revision

div.style: color: rgb(31, 53, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
03 · Assemble the context
Teacher rules, actual schema, relevant history and exact current question

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
04 · Does the context fit
the model window?

div.style: color: rgb(31, 53, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
Compact older material only when needed
Keep original source IDs and complete archives

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
05 · Call the selected model
Chat Completions, Messages or Responses; account/API transport

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
06 · Did the model request
a read-only tool?

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
Read sources within request scope and budgets
read_context: archived sources
inspect_database: captured database observations

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
07 · Validate the answer contract
Separate explanation, teaching examples and one complete runnable SQL batch

div.style: color: rgb(96, 73, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
08 · Is the request still current
and the action permitted?

div.style: color: rgb(96, 73, 35) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
Cancel or reject stale work
Do not apply delayed SQL to another workspace or revision

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
09 · Choose the permitted
execution path

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
Explanation only
Display text and non-runnable teaching examples

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
Read-only worker
Snapshot or connection; deadline and result limits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
AI write batch
SAVEPOINT; constraints, triggers and applicable preservation checks

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p: Independent entry: manual SQL editor

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
Manual SQL / explicit transaction
Separate execution contract and actual partial or transaction state

div.style: color: rgb(31, 53, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
10 · Record the observed outcome
Actual tables, complete SQL, errors and changes with source identities

div.style: color: rgb(96, 73, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Eligible failure and shared
repair budget still unused?

div.style: color: rgb(96, 73, 35) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
One conditional repair
Use the original request and actual error or evidence; check the complete answer again

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
11 · Show the outcome
Actual results beside the explanation; expose errors and changes

div.style: color: rgb(31, 53, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 330px; text-align: center; width: 330px;

span.p:
12 · Keep evidence for follow-up questions
Conversation, operation records and complete result archives
